comparison.objective: These rows pursue objectives other than separating finishing media from retained workpieces through a lifted manual screen; they instead cover routing, assembly, inspection, transport, dispensing, fastening, safety, servicing, or other manipulation outcomes.
comparison.physical_skill: None clearly tests the candidate's coupled ability of bimanual load-shared screen grasping, orientation-sensitive many-body passage through physical apertures, simultaneous retention of larger ring workpieces, and accurate reseating and release.
comparison.success_condition: Their success conditions concern task-specific placements, connections, measurements, cuts, latches, transfers, or safe states—not media recovery through apertures plus washer retention, spill and invalid-passage exclusions, dual-support reseating, release clearance, and a fresh three-second dwell.
comparison.reason: They are clearly unrelated on objective, tested physical ability, and success condition; superficial sharing of two hands, containers, loose objects, or placement does not establish duplication.
